_doc: Recommended music-video transitions per version-presets.js preset. Picked for aesthetic resonance with the preset's dominant visual trait (high grain → film-style transitions, high chroma → RGB-distortion transitions, etc.). Sources: gap-analysis 2026-09-12 §3 PRD-019 note; observed in 2020-2026 music videos; tested against the 29 transitions in engine-transitions.client.js.

_family_legend.cover: Hide the cut behind motion (whip pan, swivel, pass-through). Universal.
_family_legend.distortion: RGB / glitch / pixelation. Pairs with cyberpunk, lo-fi, electronic.
_family_legend.spatial: Zoom / camera roll / push-in. Drama, climaxes.
_family_legend.brightness: Flash, flare, strobe. Drops, hits, emotional beats.
_family_legend.mask: Iris, paint stroke, shape wipe. Reveal / conceal.
_family_legend.fade: Crossfade, fade to black, dip to color. The grammar of endings.
_family_legend.wipe: Linear / radial wipe. Pacing, section transitions.

film.label: 16mm
film.rationale: Grain + sepia + vignette = warm 70s doc aesthetic. Pair with on-camera transitions that don't fight the texture.

grid.label: Monochrome cells
grid.rationale: Posterize + grayscale = pixel-perfect hard cuts. Transitions that emphasize the digital subdivision.

neon.label: Magenta/cyan electric
neon.rationale: Chroma aberration + glow = pure RGB-distortion territory. Let the colors split and bloom.

smoke.label: Cream warm blur
smoke.rationale: Heavy blur + slow drift = hazy, soft-focus transitions. Don't fight the softness.

hallucination.label: Heavy mutation (algo=2 liquid)
hallucination.rationale: Liquid warp substrate. Pair with transitions that are themselves warped or that amplify the surrealism.

eclipse.label: Dark vignette
eclipse.rationale: Massive R / chrome / Massive Attack. Restraint — only let the dark reveal transitions through.

aurora.label: Pastel soft
aurora.rationale: Light grain, low mutation. Pastoral/Björk/Sigur Rós territory — let the transitions breathe.

chrome.label: Liquid metal
chrome.rationale: Med-high everything, algo 2 (liquid). 90s electronic / Daft Punk 'Around the World'.

fractal.label: Mandelbrot / psychedelic
fractal.rationale: High mutation, kaleidoscopic substrate. Transitions that recurse or mirror.

glitch.label: Aphex / Death Grips
glitch.rationale: High chroma + mutAlgo=1. The whole substrate is broken — transitions should match.

pulse.label: Club strobe / rave
pulse.rationale: mutAlgo=4 (ripple). The whole frame is pulsing — transitions should ripple or strobe.

void.label: Minimalist performance
void.rationale: James Blake / black frame minimalism. Transitions should be invisible or just absence.

watercolor.label: Indie folk soft
watercolor.rationale: Bon Iver / soft painterly. Transitions that feel hand-applied.

baroque.label: Gilded / Arcade Fire
baroque.rationale: Sepia + glow = ornate, gilded. Transitions that feel stage-lit and dramatic.

gallery.label: Gallery-white clean
gallery.rationale: Stub preset (PRD gallery page). Clean transitions that don't compete with the artwork.

kraft.label: Paper grain DIY
kraft.rationale: Lo-fi / zine aesthetic. Transitions that feel photocopied or hand-cut.

mosaic.label: Stained glass
mosaic.rationale: Posterize high, no chroma. Religious-iconography transitions — discrete shapes revealing.

phosphor.label: CRT phosphor green
phosphor.rationale: 80s VHS / Stranger Things. Glow + chroma. Let the screen bleed.

tape.label: VHS lo-fi
tape.rationale: Chromatic + grain = analog degradation. Transitions that look like tape damage.
